as_told.title: Aztec crash dismissed as hoax; Steinman's book and the Ramseys' rehabilitation

plain: A UFO historian named Richard Dolan told podcast host Jesse Michels about a claimed crash of a flying saucer near Aztec, New Mexico, around 1948, which he calls the first such case ever written about, and says he believes it. He says the story was attacked and dismissed in the years after, that a writer named William Steinman wrote a big book on it, and that later researchers Scott and Suzanne Ramsey brought it back to respectability, even though the online encyclopedia Wikipedia still labels it fake. If true, it would be one of the earliest recovered crashed craft in America.
